questions: Should the FFT be performed on the sum of each row (a single 1D array of row sums) or on each row individually (multiple FFTs, one per row)?
If multiple FFTs are performed (one per row), how should they be plotted? Overlaid on the same axes, or separate subplots?
Should the x-axis be labeled or have a title beyond the default index? The clarification only says what it corresponds to, not whether to label it.
Should the y-axis be labeled (e.g., 'Magnitude' or 'Absolute Value')?
Is the FFT computed using scipy.fftpack.fft (as in reference) or numpy.fft.fft? The import is scipy.fftpack, but implementation could differ.
Should the plot include grid lines, specific line styles, or markers?
What should happen if the input array is not 2D? Should it raise an error or handle 1D arrays?
Should the FFT coefficients be shifted (e.g., using fftshift) to center zero frequency, or plotted in natural order?
